name: Soyuz MS-11
about: Soyuz MS-11 (2018-098A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2018 Dec  3. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).
